name: AM Calendar Hub
type: Calendar backend registry and canonical DTO

dataIsolation.guard: Every Calendar item and backend operation carries tenant_id, actor context, visibility and action policy; backend fallback must never cross tenants.

definitionOfDone: Canonical Calendar DTO separates due date from planned date
Backend adapter interface supports Rental Calendar V2 and AM Calendar Core
All writes use idempotency keys and source version checks
Private, company, team, role-based and admin-only visibility are enforced before provider calls
Calendar source remains AM/Rental, not Google
Backend outage records failure without writing to another tenant or provider
